note:
The "AI effect". Slightly different concepts and sayings for a similar sentiment:

* "AI is whatever hasn't been done yet"

* "As soon as it becomes commonplace, it ceases to be called AI"

* "If it works, it's not AI"

Similarly moving goalposts to redefine what AI, or just intelligence, is.

"Every time we figure out how to do one of these things, it ceases to be called AI and just becomes useful software."  - Larry Tesler (?)
